title: Widzin Kwah Canyon House Museum (Widzin Kwah Diyik Be Yikh)

services.name: Rental Housing
services.desc: The Witset First Nation (WFN) Housing Department provides safe, sustainable, and affordable homes for WFN members. The department manages housing programs, construction projects, renovations, and maintenance to ensure all homes meet safety standards. Our Housing Manager, Donna Van Tunen, works with government programs to secure funding for new homes on behalf of our members. The Housing Department also maintains a Housing List, where renovation requests are organized into two categories: Mould Renovations and RRAP Renovations. If your name is already on the list and some time has passed, please visit the Housing Department to confirm your current needs and intentions, as the list is updated

services.name: Section 95 Rent-to-Own Program
services.desc: WFN works with Indigenous Services Canada (ISC) and RBC Hagwilget to provide Ministerial Loan Guarantees for eligible members. Applicants must have stable, full-time income. The Housing Department will assist with documentation and the application

blurb: Widzin Kwah Diyik Be Yikh (Widzin Kwah Canyon House Museum) is open to the public daily from 9:00am to 5:00pm, May to September. We offer 45-minute professionally guided Witsuwit’en Cultural Tours.
